reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 18. Nay or No: 22. Not Voting: 0. said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text:
Words aren’t enough to stop the violent land grab in the West Bank. With the help — or purposeful blind eye — of the Israeli government, settlers have murdered and beaten Palestinians, stolen homes and destroyed property.

That’s why I’m carrying the Stop the Settlements Act. https://t.co/kFqhS1vgFn

Israel continues to commit atrocities in Gaza. American tax dollars help pay for it. 

In fact, Israel is placing orders for military equipment in the billions. The method of payment? The mere promise of future U.S. aid. 

I demanded answers from the Trump Administration on just how much Israel is racking up. It’s a whopping $10 billion. 

The American people do not approve of funding Netanyahu’s war crimes. I will continue to demand transparency and push to end aid to Israel.

https://t.co/3KoZTiuc0Z

Last week America rebuked Donald Trump’s mass deportation campaign. It has killed people, killed communities and killed businesses. 

In January, change is coming. https://t.co/jZgKcXJIy9

On Veterans Day, we honor the military heroes who have sacrificed greatly to keep us safe and protect our freedoms.

My office joined Palo Alto College's Veterans Day ceremony to honor those who have served our nation. 

To San Antonio's servicemembers, we are grateful for you today and every day.

I joined my colleagues in demanding to see the fine print of Trump's shady oil deal with Venezuela. The admin is sending billions to Delcy Rodríguez's corrupt government where the list of who benefits is kept murky. 

The Trump Admin is fighting to keep it a secret. This report doesn't even scratch the surface on what they need to hand over to Congress. And the information that is in it raises serious concerns. 

I will continue to demand answers, and use every tool we will have with the incoming Democratic majority, including congressional hearings, to uncover what the United States is doing in Venezuela. Americans, and Venezuelans, are sick of the corruption.

https://t.co/wXA0B5D5Vr

Yesterday, I landed back in DC. Here's my recap on what's ahead for Congress. 

https://t.co/ZzQy5KgVZN

Miguel Parra Hernandez is trapped in a rehab facility after an ICE agent drove into him with a car then lied about it.

He’s guarded day and night by ICE and private prison guards from GEO Group. He’s being denied proper care and basic hygiene like baths. He has become depressed https://t.co/KF1BtVN03R

Michell Germán should have been on the field for senior night in El Paso over the weekend—not at the Dilley Trailer Prison with her family. Holding up her poster, her friends at El Paso High made sure a piece of her was there anyway.

Trump’s mass deportation campaign continues https://t.co/pJ4wgVGY3F
Happy Diwali to everyone celebrating! Wishing you and your loved ones a festival of lights full of joy, peace, and prosperity. https://t.co/9cOT8fP066

I look forward to working with Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa to shut down the Dilley Trailer Prison once and for all.

We must end family detention in America. No child should be ripped away from their lives and locked away. No private company should profit from the suffering and trauma of children.

https://t.co/WxZUTSPh15

A big congratulations to Senfronia Thompson @Senfronia4Texas on earning the support of colleagues to become the next Speaker of the Texas House of Representatives! 

I served with her for ten years. She’s a person of principle, dignity and mettle. Always a trailblazer, today she https://t.co/vOHAUEy8V9

On Tuesday, Americans rejected Trump's mass deportation agenda. Today, its architect got a promotion. 

Stephen Miller has backed lawless ICE tactics and doubled down after the killing of Alex Pretti. He tried and failed to dismantle birthright citizenship. And he drove record ICE quotas that ripped children from their parents and imprisoned babies as young two months old in a trailer prison.

Appointing Stephen Miller as White House Chief of Staff is a dangerous move that Americans do not want.

With Democrats in power, we need to end family detention. Until then, we need to do everything we can to rein in ICE and stop traumatizing kids and families.

I called ICE this morning to demand they restore video calls at the Dilley Trailer Prison. I’ve seen mothers of babies https://t.co/c0KUhKMYeu

CoreCivic is the company that makes money imprisoning young children in Dilley, TX. 

Some of the largest private equity and asset management companies have huge stakes in CoreCivic. #EndChildDetention #ShutDownDilley https://t.co/abSj1nGdgV

The American people expect Congress to no longer turn a blind eye to the horrors taking place in Gaza and the violent land grab happening in the West Bank. 

That’s why I’m carrying the Stop the Settlements Act to impose sanctions on any individual or institution driving settlements in the West Bank or Gaza. Under our new Democratic Majority, it should be taken up for a vote in the new Congress.

Michell Germán should be getting ready for Senior Night this Friday. Instead, she’s locked away at the Dilley Trailer Prison with her parents and younger sister. I met with the family last week. Michell is a bright young student at a magnet school in El Paso, the Center for Career and Technology Education, who’s working toward her cosmetology license and dreams of a career in medicine. Her younger sister Paola attends Lamar Elementary and is only 11 years old. 

On Friday, Michell's teammates will carry her picture onto the field. But she's missing memories she'll never get back. 

ICE should release the family immediately. Now is the time for Democrats to get to work, shut down the Dilley Trailer Prison, and end family detention once and for all.
It’s a new day for Texas and the nation.

It’s Election Day, Texas! 

Polls are open until 7 PM CT. Find your polling location at https://t.co/9ZDbOQFzFu and make your voice heard. https://t.co/iAdWi0YmZg

Some young people seeking nominations for our US Military Academies who live in Texas’ 23rd Congressional have reached out to my office asking to be considered for nomination. However, I am only allowed to nominate students residing within the 20th Congressional District. 

Because Governor Greg Abbott failed to schedule an election to replace Congressman Tony Gonzalez, these aspiring cadets have no member of Congress to nominate them for an academy appointment. They may still apply through the Texas US Senate offices but the most common and achievable route to nomination is unavailable to them because of the Governor’s delay. 

The deadline to submit to our office is November 13th at 6 PM CT.

Tomorrow is Election Day, San Antonio! 

Know your rights at the polls. Make your voice heard. And encourage your loved ones to cast their ballot too! https://t.co/nJcImrTg38
Adela, mom of newborn, has been released from Dilley. Thank you to everyone who spoke up! #EndChildDetention #ShutDownDilley https://t.co/2Qxkga2F42

Adela and daughter Sofia are now home!

Adela was locked away at the Dilley Trailer Prison four weeks after giving birth to her son. Parents know the first few weeks with a newborn are so precious and important. ICE took them away from her. Sofia too suffered from being locked https://t.co/caH0wudcHZ

I visited Octavio Daniel Cabrera Valdez today at the Karnes detention center. He told me he was served rice and beans with a stone in it and cracked his molar. He needs surgery yet ICE has only given him ibuprofen.

This kind of medical neglect is common. Octavio should be https://t.co/Xx1q4vV3jL
Update: Trump and Abbott’s Mass Deportation devastates Texas. https://t.co/r1VSzz4O2v

Octavio Daniel Cabrera Valdez was at work when ICE took him away from the family he was raising in San Antonio. He’s been at the Karnes detention center since April. 

Today, I’ll meet again with Octavio and others to check on their wellbeing and monitor conditions.

Octavio said there isn’t always enough food and he goes to bed hungry. He gets rashes from not having soap to wash his clothes. When he had a migraine, ICE let him languish for hours before giving him medicine. 

Back home, Octavio’s young son and daughter are suffering too. He was the family’s breadwinner. His partner and children had to move out of their apartment. They’ve lost more than their home—they’ve lost time together. Since being locked away, he has missed birthdays, Mother’s Day, and the kids’ back to school. 

Octavio should be released immediately and reunited with his family.

Dolores Huerta was a trailblazing civil rights leader who fought for the dignity of farm workers and migrant laborers. Organizing walkouts, boycotts, and nonviolent protests, she transformed the U.S. labor movement and improved countless lives. 

We must honor her legacy,

Four weeks after giving birth, Adela Nohemy Castellanos was torn from her newborn son and family. Today, she and her daughter Sofia are still locked away at the Dilley Trailer Prison. I’m going to Dilley this week to see Adela and Sofia, and push for their release.

Adela’s case https://t.co/rDJG066bAc

Losing an election is not grounds for asylum.

Yet the Trump Administration is giving Flávio Bolsonaro safe haven in the United States. In Brazil, he is under investigation for alleged corruption, money laundering and currency evasion, and was ordered to surrender his passports.

On Saturday, my staff attended the 2026 Texas Veterans Service Fair to help San Antonio veterans get help claiming VA benefits, health care, and more. We owe it to our military heroes to make sure they get the care and benefits they deserve and have earned. 

Thank you to State Rep. Barbara Gervin-Hawkins and St. Philip's College's Good Samaritan Veterans Outreach and Transition Center for hosting.

Congratulations to President @LulaOficial on his reelection, and to the people of Brazil for exercising their right to participate in their democracy. I look forward to continuing to build the partnership between the United States and Brazil. https://t.co/ydhXhg2iie

Do you live in San Antonio’s 20th District and want to serve our country? My office is now accepting applications for nominations to the U.S. Military Academy, U.S. Naval Academy, U.S. Air Force Academy, and U.S. Merchant Marine Academy. 

Applications are due November 13 by 6:00 https://t.co/vwcgdkEtu0

Today, the Fifth Circuit stripped immigrants facing detention in Texas, Louisiana, and Mississippi of their right to due process. People who have lived in our communities for years, even decades, can now be locked away with no chance to see a judge or ask for bond. It’s a radical https://t.co/mUUyf7aveF
So all that simping for Trump by Greg Abbott and he can’t even get some FEMA money out of him? https://t.co/u7kAhjY31q

No American should have a federal agent knock on their door demanding they prove their citizenship ahead of the election. Under Trump, agents did just that.

Our democracy requires free and fair elections. Not voter intimidation. This is despicable.

https://t.co/iiHsmziZai
@bradlander I hope you’re safe and doing alright out there. I look forward to working with you next year.

Today, Israeli forces detained dozens of volunteers, including a congressional candidate and rabbis, in the West Bank. Days earlier, settlers attacked European diplomats and a Washington Post journalist.

If American public servants, diplomats, and journalists are targeted,

Early voting has started in Texas!

From now until October 30th, cast your ballot at any early voting location near you. 

Our democracy works when everyone takes part, so make a plan and make your voice heard! For more information on locations and hours, visit https://t.co/FTaF0BEXMI.

Air Force Tech. Sergeant Ian Patterson tragically died after a skills demonstration incident at the Alamodome. He gave 15 years to our country and trained the next generation of airmen at Joint Base San Antonio-Lackland. 

As the investigation into his death begins, his family deserves clear answers, and I urge the Air Force to be fully transparent about what happened. My heart is with his family, his loved ones, and his fellow airmen.

Today’s violent attack is an example of why Congress should take up my bill, the Stop the Settlements Act, which would impose sanctions on anyone looking to take Palestinian land.

Dozens of Israeli settlers attacked Palestinian villagers during an olive harvest in the West Bank. https://t.co/d1yK6LTgto

San Antonio Seniors: Enroll in Medicare or change your plan now until December 7th.
 
Compare coverage options or choose a new plan by visiting https://t.co/naOMPGp7Q2 or by calling 1-800-MEDICARE.
 
If you have additional questions or need support, call my office at https://t.co/iCzoGWrciI

The Stop the Settlements Act would sanction anyone looking to take Palestinian land in the West Bank or Gaza. And support keeps growing.

Since I introduced the bill alongside Reps. Dean, Beyer, Casar, Jacobs, and Escobar, over 50 members have now co-sponsored.

Settlement https://t.co/2hkxS8moys

I’m glad to see the City of San Antonio taking ICE to court. ICE wants to hold up to 1,500 people a day in an East Side warehouse next to a floodplain, and it still hasn’t told the city how it will handle water, sewage, or emergencies. 

We’ve seen what happens inside these https://t.co/VU4tCSmfwI
Happy Indigenous Peoples' Day! Today, we honor the history, culture, and contributions of the Native Nations and communities who have shaped our region for generations. https://t.co/Wrs2NSBFrd

San Antonio students! The 2026 Congressional App Challenge has launched! Have an idea for an app? Now’s your chance to build it. The challenge is open to middle and high school students across our district, and this year’s winner will earn a trip to Washington for a special

Just two months after giving birth to her son, Adela Nohemy Castellanos is locked away at the Dilley Trailer Prison with her 10-year-old daughter, Sofia. They are separated from dad and three other siblings. 

Adela can't tolerate the food, is very stressed, and can’t sleep. https://t.co/7KoJ4FF1l9

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
